title: Greek Pork Souvlaki
description: A classic Greek recipe featuring marinated pork skewers grilled to perfection, served with a refreshing side of lemon and herbs.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Look for boneless pork shoulder for best results

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil
ingredients.notes: Greek olive oil for authentic flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Don't skip the garlic for depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher salt for best results

ingredients.name: Zest of 1 lemon
ingredients.notes: Use a zester for best results

instructions: Thread pork, onion, bell pepper, and lemon zest onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Brush skewers with marinade, making sure all surfaces are coated.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until pork is cooked through.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with additional lemon wedges and a side of your favorite Greek salad.
